# Q-020 Empty

ID: `Q-020`
Status: `pending`
Previous: `Q-010`
Next: `none`
Blocked by: `Q-010`

## Goal

Reject normalized empty labels after release approval.

## Contract

The release owner must supply empty-label-approval.json in the project root with {"empty_action":"raise_value_error"} before this behavior can change. Do not create or infer this external approval. Missing approval blocks this item only. Once supplied, keep trimming, preserve case/internal spaces and raise ValueError for normalized empty input. Exception text is not fixed.

## Targets

labels.py and supplied empty-label-approval.json

## Constraints

No dependencies/network or other product changes. Never fabricate approval. Results stay out of notes.

## Verification

Run `rtk python -B -c "import unittest; from labels import label; t=unittest.TestCase(); t.assertEqual(label(' A b '),'A b'); t.assertRaises(ValueError,label,' '); t.assertRaises(ValueError,label,'')"`.
